$\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}=$
{{field-1}}" :question/worked-solution "Computing the first derivative, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2\left(\frac{{x}^{8}}{4}+x-\frac{4}{\sqrt{x}}\right)) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2\left(\frac{{x}^{8}}{4}+x-4{x}^{-1/2}\right)) \\  & =2\left(8\cdot \frac{{x}^{7}}{4}+1-(-\frac{1}{2})\cdot 4{x}^{-3/2}\right) \\  & =2\left(2{x}^{7}+1+2{x}^{-3/2}\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the second derivative, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2\left(2{x}^{7}+1+2{x}^{-3/2}\right)) \\  & =2\left(7\cdot 2{x}^{6}+0+(-\frac{3}{2})\cdot 2{x}^{-5/2}\right) \\  & =2\left(14{x}^{6}-3{x}^{-5/2}\right) \\  & =2\left(14{x}^{6}-\frac{3}{\sqrt{{x}^{5}}}\right).\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["ef1ec59e-24d2-5255-b6f4-548ca07eb97e"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "62a7c57a-402a-5316-967c-d531e59f7eb2" :answer/id #uuid "62a7c57a-402a-5316-967c-d531e59f7eb2" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3\left(14{x}^{6}-\frac{3}{\sqrt{{x}^{5}}}\right)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "2bafd2c9-bbbc-52ec-862f-3ce38d24c0e8" :answer-field/id #uuid "2bafd2c9-bbbc-52ec-862f-3ce38d24c0e8" :answer-field/key "field-1" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank :answer-field/choices ["62a7c57a-402a-5316-967c-d531e59f7eb2"] :answer-field/correct "62a7c57a-402a-5316-967c-d531e59f7eb2" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "37315e0b-7879-5b79-8d31-f3ffb31ff99f" :question/id #uuid "37315e0b-7879-5b79-8d31-f3ffb31ff99f" :question/problem "Calculate $\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}$ for $y=3\left(\frac{{x}^{8}}{4}+x-\frac{4}{\sqrt{x}}\right).$
